title: 天皇賞（秋）の後に・Der Stolz

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Eishin Flash kneels before me and her parents to show her respect and admiration after taking first place at the Tokyo Racecourse—the very same track where she won the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her parents are thrilled with her victory and tell her how proud they are.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her goal achieved, Eishin Flash is filled with excitement for her final challenge—the Arima Kinen. And although I, too, am excited…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …I decide to draft up a schedule for her that extends past the Arima Kinen in the hope that she'll continue to run.
